_levels: same_org asks whether two rows name the SAME ORGANIZATION. A named sub-body (council, society, committee) belongs to its parent organization and separates at the ROUTE level instead — see sub_body_routes. Conflating the two levels was the first mistake made while writing this fixture.
_method: HAND-CURATED. Every pair below was read individually against the predecessor export (GTM-Event-Tracker/tracker-export/All Opportunities.csv). These are not auto-generated: an automated labeller cannot tell a name variant from a sibling sub-body, which is exactly the judgement being tested. The easy classes in dedupe_labelled.json ARE auto-generated from independent signals; this file is the part that needs a person.
_rule: same_org=true means one organization under a name variant. same_org=false means genuinely distinct bodies that a naive key would merge.
